result.question: Quais são os 10 municípios que atendem mais pacientes?
result.gold_sql: SELECT m.nome AS municipio, COUNT(i."N_AIH") AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" JOIN municipios m ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = m.codigo_6d GROUP BY m.nome ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: SELECT mu."nome" AS municipio, COUNT(i."N_AIH") AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" JOIN municipios mu ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = mu."codigo_6d" GROUP BY mu."nome" ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;
